bRollImages.prompt: A warm-lit cozy living room. A parent and young child (around 8 years old) sit at a wooden kitchen table covered with scattered homework papers and pencils. The child looks down at a math worksheet with a confused expression, pencil in hand. The parent sits beside them looking concerned but loving. Soft warm evening lighting from a nearby lamp. Cinematic, photorealistic, shallow depth of field. No text or watermarks.

Close-up macro shot of a child's small hand erasing an answer on a math worksheet with a pink eraser. Eraser shavings visible on the paper. A crumpled piece of paper sits nearby. Soft focus background. Warm, slightly melancholic lighting. Photorealistic, shallow depth of field.

A stylized world map on a dark navy background with glowing teal and orange dots marking countries. Clean, modern, minimalist design. The dots emit a soft glow. Subtle grid lines overlay the map. Professional infographic style with dark background. No text, no labels.

A warm, cozy family scene. A smiling parent sits on a comfortable couch with two children (ages approximately 6 and 9). Each child holds a tablet device, looking engaged and happy. The parent looks at their phone with a satisfied expression. Warm, inviting home environment with soft lighting and houseplants in background. Photorealistic, warm color grading.

A joyful child (around 7-8 years old) raising both fists in the air in celebration, big smile on their face. They are sitting at a desk with a tablet in front of them. Colorful confetti-like light effects around them. Bright, uplifting lighting. Photorealistic, vibrant, warm colors.
